Students path to leadership and entrepreneurial success is distinctly unique. At Northwood University, they honor this by offering a robust MBA program in three flexible formats, each infused with The DeVos Difference. Students immerse themselves in a learning experience where immediate workplace application, system-wide capstone events, integrated curriculums, problem-based methodologies, and scholarship opportunities converge to redefine their career journey.

Accelerated MBA

Students get to seize the opportunity to accelerate their career trajectory with the one-year Accelerated MBA Program. Designed for ambitious individuals from diverse undergraduate backgrounds, this program compresses a wealth of knowledge and experience into 12 transformative months. Students will engage in hands-on fieldwork consulting, gaining an edge in the competitive business landscape.

Features of the program

  • 12 months duration
  • 36 credit hours
  • Offered in Midland, MI

Note: Deadline for paying deposit if admitted. Recommended to pay as soon as admitted for the student to have sufficient time for visa process steps, but no later than 30 days prior to the intake they have applied for.
